title: All .csproj missing GenerateDocumentationFile=true
rationale: Adding <GenerateDocumentationFile>true</GenerateDocumentationFile> to PropertyGroup is a build metadata change. Build will succeed; it will now produce an .xml doc file. No runtime change. No test impact.
validation_command: dotnet build src/net/fods/FormatFactory.Fods.csproj --configuration Release && dotnet build src/net/fodt/FormatFactory.Fodt.csproj --configuration Release && dotnet build src/net/netpbm/FormatFactory.Netpbm.csproj --configuration Release
risks: May reveal missing XML doc comments as compiler warnings (CS1591) — these are warnings not errors unless TreatWarningsAsErrors is set. Check first.
note: Warnings check required before applying — if TreatWarningsAsErrors=true, this would need coordinated fix with XML doc comments added. Investigate first.

title: Netpbm .csproj missing PackageReadmeFile
rationale: src/net/netpbm/README.md does not exist (confirmed via glob scan). PackageReadmeFile requires a README.md present and packed. Creating a README.md without user-provided content is blocked by session instructions (no doc files without explicit request). User must provide README content or authorize creation.
fix_scope: src/net/netpbm/README.md (create — NEEDS USER AUTHORIZATION), then src/net/netpbm/FormatFactory.Netpbm.csproj — add PackageReadmeFile element
risks: README.md content must be user-provided or explicitly authorized
pre_check_required: User must authorize README.md creation and provide content

title: FodsCsvExporter.cs stale header comments
rationale: Removing or updating misleading header comments in a source file. No logic change. No test impact. Rollback trivial.

title: No pyproject.toml in any Python package
rationale: Creating pyproject.toml files for Python packages is a pure addition — no existing files modified. However: 10 packages is a large scope; each package needs its own pyproject.toml. Start with the two most recently modified packages (abw, gnumeric) as a pilot fix to demonstrate the pattern. Remaining packages queued as FIX_LATER for user to decide scope.
validation_command: .local/venv/Scripts/pip install -e src/python/abw/ && .local/venv/Scripts/python -c "import abw; print('abw import ok:', abw.__version__)"
risks: Creating pyproject.toml from scratch requires correct package name, version, entry points. If incorrect, pip install will fail. Must follow existing package structure exactly.
note: Pilot: abw + gnumeric only. Full fix for all 10 packages should be a separate sprint or user-directed.

title: fods_py and fodt_py missing __version__ in __init__.py
rationale: Add __version__ = '0.1.0.dev0' to __init__.py — pure addition, no logic change, no test impact.
validation_command: .local/venv/Scripts/python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src/python'); import fods; print(fods.__version__); import fodt; print(fodt.__version__)"
